name: Cable Glands
summary: Brass cable glands in five types, from IP 54 indoor to IP 66 weather proof and marine, in brass, nickel or chrome finish.
intro: Brass cable glands for armoured and unarmoured cables, in five types: BW, CW, E1W, A1/A2 and Marine. Pick the type by cable construction and the environment.
features: Cable ranges from 10 mm to 75 mm
Brass, nickel or chrome finish, or as specified

variants.name: BW type
variants.summary: Single armour clamping. No loose parts and easy to install. Most suitable for SWA, plastic or rubber sheathed cables. Used in dry indoor conditions.

facts.label: Finish
facts.value: Brass, nickel, chrome or as specified

variants.name: CW type
variants.summary: Provides cable retention and a seal onto the cable outer sheath. Outdoor or indoor use. For non-armoured elastomer and plastic insulated cables; may be used on cables with inner and outer sheaths.

facts.label: Finish
facts.value: Brass, nickel, chrome or as specified

variants.name: E1W type
variants.summary: Separate armour lock rings and a seal on the cable inner sheath. Suitable for SWA or rubber sheathed cables. Outer seal grips the bedding layer for use in most climatic conditions. Weather proof and water proof.

facts.label: Finish
facts.value: Brass, nickel, chrome or as specified

variants.name: A1/A2 type
variants.summary: Provides a cable retention seal onto the cable outer sheath. Suitable for unarmoured or rubber sheathed cables, indoors and outdoors.

facts.label: Finish
facts.value: Brass, nickel, chrome or as specified
